description: This file contains utility functions and classes for processing and augmenting request data in a proxy server context, specifically for the Litellm project. It handles header sanitization, metadata extraction, callback configuration, guardrail management, and request tracing for LLM API calls.

classes.name: KeyAndTeamLoggingSettings
classes.description: Helper class to retrieve dynamic logging settings for user API keys and teams.

methods.name: parse_cache_control
methods.description: Parses Cache-Control header into a dictionary of directives.

methods.name: _get_metadata_variable_name
methods.description: Determines the request data field name for metadata based on the request URL.

methods.name: safe_add_api_version_from_query_params
methods.description: Adds 'api_version' to data from request query parameters if present.

methods.name: convert_key_logging_metadata_to_callback
methods.description: Converts callback data into a TeamCallbackMetadata object, updating success/failure callback lists.

methods.name: KeyAndTeamLoggingSettings
methods.description: Class providing static methods to retrieve logging settings for keys and teams.

methods.name: _get_dynamic_logging_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves dynamic logging callback settings based on user API key metadata or config.

methods.name: clean_headers
methods.description: Removes sensitive or special headers from request headers.

methods.name: add_litellm_data_to_request
methods.description: Main function to augment request data with metadata, headers, tracing, and other info before proxying.

methods.name: _update_model_if_team_alias_exists
methods.description: Replaces model with team alias if configured.

methods.name: _update_model_if_key_alias_exists
methods.description: Replaces model with key alias if configured.

methods.name: _get_enforced_params
methods.description: Retrieves list of enforced parameters from settings and metadata.

methods.name: check_if_token_is_service_account
methods.description: Checks if a user API key token is a service account.

methods.name: _enforced_params_check
methods.description: Validates that required enforced parameters are present in request body.

methods.name: _add_guardrails_from_key_or_team_metadata
methods.description: Combines guardrails from key and team metadata into request data.

methods.name: move_guardrails_to_metadata
methods.description: Transfers guardrails from request or key metadata into request metadata.

methods.name: add_provider_specific_headers_to_request
methods.description: Adds provider-specific headers (e.g., Anthropic) to request data.

methods.name: _add_otel_traceparent_to_data
methods.description: Forwards traceparent header into request data for tracing if enabled.
